name: Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size
definition: The **Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size** is $\max_{\mathcal{G}\subseteq\mathcal{H}}\mathrm{TS}_{\min}^p(\mathcal{G})$, the largest minimum projected teaching-set size over all subclasses.
graph_summary: Largest minimum projected teaching-set size over subclasses.

monotonic.proof: The parameter is a maximum of minimum projected teaching-set size over all subfamilies. Enlarging the class only enlarges the collection over which this maximum is taken.

p_monotonic.proof: Let F be a subfamily of a projection pi_T(H). Choose one preimage in H for each member of F, obtaining a subfamily G with pi_T(G)=F. Projection monotonicity of minimum projected teaching-set size gives its value on F at most its value on G, which is at most the maximum over all subfamilies of H.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.
